title: October 15, 1931: a fisherman's son was born in Rameswaram. He would go on to run India's missile program and its presidency.

sources.text: Wikipedia - A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
PressReader (A to Z India) - Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam: Career scientist and Science administrator

caption:
October 15, 1931: a fisherman's son was born in Rameswaram. He would go on to run India's missile program and its presidency.

He joined DRDO in 1958 and moved to ISRO in 1969, where he served as Project Director for India's first satellite launch vehicle, SLV-III - before returning to DRDO to lead the development of missiles like Agni and Prithvi.

He served as President from 2002 to 2007, elected with backing from both the ruling and opposition parties. He received the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour, in 1997.

Kalam's path - from a fisherman's son to missile scientist to President - showed that India's highest offices could be reached through technical achievement, not just political careers.
